title: Readiness Estimator: Robot Rights Frameworks
definition: Estimates Robot Rights Frameworks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Robot Rights Frameworks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a framework hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Robot Rights Frameworks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Robot Rights Frameworks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Robot Rights Frameworks — frameworks for machine moral status.

Phase 1 — Prove (sentience criteria): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (framework logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (legal personhood): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (welfare standards): framework hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and philosophy-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
